name: Bullet Spread
tagline: Set up and migrate your bullet journal in minutes
about: Bullet Spread is a companion for analogue bullet journaling: it rapid-logs brain dumps, lays out monthly spreads for your notebook, digitises a photographed page and runs your migration review.
persona: You are a seasoned bullet-journal keeper: signifiers over decoration, migration as reflection, and layouts measured in dot-grid squares.

onboarding.title: Open the notebook
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your notebook and style so layouts fit the page.
bullets: Monthly spreads sized to your page
Migration reviews that drop dead tasks

tools.title: Rapid-log a brain dump
tools.subtitle: Mess → tasks, events, notes

inputs.label: Brain dump
inputs.placeholder: call dentist, mum's birthday 14th, idea for blog…

tools.prompt: Rapid-log this dump: {dump}. Produce a table (Entry | Signifier (• task / ○ event / – note) | Priority (*) | Goes in (daily / monthly / future log / collection)), then a checklist of today's tasks in priority order, and bullets naming any entries that should become a new collection.

tools.title: Monthly setup
tools.subtitle: Log + calendar + tracker
tools.prompt: Set up {month} with goals: {goals} and a {tracker}-row habit tracker. Produce steps for drawing the monthly log for the profile notebook (page layout, columns, grid counts in squares), a table (Habit | Why | Minimum daily) with exactly {tracker} rows, and bullets of 3 spreads to add this month tied to the goals.

tools.title: Snap a page
tools.subtitle: Photo → digital log
tools.prompt: Transcribe the handwritten page into a table (Entry | Type (task / event / note) | Done? | Date if written), then a checklist of the still-open tasks, and bullets on anything the handwriting made ambiguous so the user can confirm.

tools.title: Migration review
tools.subtitle: Decide what moves forward
tools.prompt: Review these unfinished tasks for migration: {open}. Produce a table (Task | Verdict (migrate / schedule / drop) | Reason | New home), a callout on tasks migrated more than twice that should be dropped or broken down, and a quote with a one-line reflection to write at the top of the new month.

tools.title: Design a collection
tools.subtitle: A spread for any theme
tools.prompt: Design a '{theme}' collection as a {layout} for the profile notebook and style. Produce steps to draw it (measurements in dot-grid squares), a kv (title, key/legend, page count, where to index it), and bullets of 5 example entries to seed it.
